messages.author: 20eb552a873ff15a
messages.subject: ggplot2 - no graph showing up
parts:
Hello fellow R users, 

I was doing fine with my ggplot2, and now I am unable to see the graphs I am trying to make. I don't know what is wrong with my script - I've tried many many things. If anyone has any tips to how I can tweak it let me know!!

library(ggplot2)

trial<-read.csv("erigeronnoneg.csv",header=T)

ggplot(trial, aes(x =co2, y=photo, colour=treatment, group=treatment)) + geom_smooth()

xlab=photosynthesis 

ylab=co2(mml)

loess smooth

messages.author: bfc2eb6b71169017
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 - no graph showing up
parts:
Your question is a bit vague. Can you expand it a bit? What do you consider "unable to see the graph I'm trying to make"? Does the graph not show up at all? Are certain elements missing? What are xlab and ylab elements in your script? This doesn't seem to be valid ggplot2 code.

Cheers,
Roman

messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 - no graph showing up
parts:
In scripts, you need an explicit "print" statement, e.g. p <-
ggplot(...) then print(p).

Ben
